ratingReasons.gameplay: Recoveries, replenishment, charge interruptions and distinct coil targets make a coherent mission. My exposed stationary firing was punished. Navigation and distinguishing clean target lines consumed considerable effort; both runs died.
ratingReasons.presentation: Strong title/end typography, rain, wet-ground light, teal/amber palette and the large relay landmark create atmosphere. Geometry, robots, equipment and weapon remain conspicuously simple and repetitive.
ratingReasons.usability: Visible key hints, map freeze, objective distance, floor rings and exact outside-reach feedback enabled independent progress. Collision near machinery repeatedly defeated apparently plausible movement; service interactions were not learned.
ratingReasons.readability: Large mission and health text works well. Enemies overlap receiver signage, pillars/shutters obstruct firing, and several announcements plus coil panel compete with combat. Small compass/map and low-contrast material boundaries require interpretation.
ratingReasons.AAAReadiness: This is a promising bounded vertical slice by observed scope and finish. Simple assets, limited encounter variety and readability/navigation friction remain far from a polished large-production release; rating is an opinion within this limited test.
